ageAccess.limited: Selected shepherd passages may be used for Emerging Reader 6–8 with adult guidance
ageAccess.earlyLearner: Not approved as an unrestricted chapter for ages 3–5

blockingFindings.issue: The imperative 'do not follow strangers' turns sheep-metaphor narration into a direct child rule and can reinforce an overbroad stranger-danger message despite the later family qualification.
'I lay it down by myself' can mean without assistance rather than voluntarily, losing the source relationship expressed by 'of myself'.
blockingFindings.replacement: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down by my own choice. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it up again. I received this command from my Father.

blockingFindings.issue: 'Those people' resolves the disputed Psalm 82 referent as human even though the meaning field correctly preserves multiple interpretations. Standard 2.1 forbids resolving that ambiguity inside the translation.
blockingFindings.replacement: If he called them gods, to whom God's word came—and Scripture cannot be broken—

blockingFindings.issue: The independent verse record begins with a lowercase continuation and ends with an unmatched quotation mark, so it is not natural or self-contained when displayed or read alone.
blockingFindings.replacement: Then why do you say of the one whom the Father set apart and sent into the world, 'You are blaspheming,' because I said, 'I am the Son of God'?

resolvedAreas: Chapter-level age access and sensitivity are declared.

Violence, abandonment, sacrifice, physical-protection promises, religious prejudice, mental-health stigma, unsafe obedience, private-voice framing, and forced reconciliation are handled in appropriate non-translation fields.
Questions and activities are varied, non-coercive, and generally permit safe adult support or passing where sensitive.
Illustrations are non-graphic, non-stigmatizing, and avoid literal depictions of the Father or Spirit.
All other chapter and verse fields pass this child-learning and safeguarding review.
passCondition: Apply only the four listed corrections, reseal the chapter, and obtain fresh theology and child reviews for the new hash.
